positions.invalidation: Close the pay if March 2027 SOFR trades at or below 4.40, which would unwind the inflation impulse. Do not add a euro short or a yen short to soften it.
positions.thesis: October CPI at 0.4 percent and Brent at 95.82 leave cash SOFR at 3.89 low versus a path that is only 4.615 by March 2027. The two-year at 4.86 and the ten-year at 5.1 show the impulse is already in the cash curve, which is a reason to size the pay so a squeeze does not threaten the book, not a reason to receive in front of oil and the CPI print. Canada and Australia are different paths. Dollar-yen at 159.70 is the wrong dollar expression. The concentrated book is one outright March SOFR pay…

pms.thesis: March 2027 SOFR at 4.58 still prices a large step up from 3.90 effective funding, and the strip keeps rising through September 2027. The fresh settlement is only a few basis points through the 4.615 entry, which is not a reason to cut or to add a second clip. The book stays concentrated in that one pay.

AUDUSD at 0.676 has just broken its 20-day range to the downside, so a long sits in the path of continuation. USDJPY at 159.60 is a failed-break short that still pays the dollar-over-yen funding gap if price squeezes. SOFR March 2027 at 4.58 already marks a higher path than 3.90 spot, so both a receive and a pay have about zero expected mark change.
